sources.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE admin.finding.severity = :severity_1) AS errors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE admin.finding.severity = :severity_2) AS warnings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE admin.finding.severity = :severity_3) AS info, count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST((admin.finding.metadata[:metadata_1] ->> :param_1) AS INTEGER) <= :param_2 OR (admin.finding.metadata[:metadata_2][:param_3] @> :param_4::JSONB)) AS urgent, admin.finding.rule 
FROM admin.finding 
WHERE admin.finding.status != :status_1 GROUP BY admin.finding.rule

sources.description: Registrierte Runtime-Abfrage. Ausführung zeigt maximal 50 Zeilen. Sicherheitsprojektion: opaque JSON-/Snapshot-/Mailfelder der Runtime werden ausgelassen.
sources.sql:
SELECT admin.finding.id AS id, admin.finding.rule AS rule, admin.finding.severity AS severity, admin.finding.entity_type AS entity_type, admin.finding.entity_id AS entity_key, admin.finding.field AS field, admin.finding.message AS message, admin.finding.first_seen_at AS first_seen_at, admin.finding.last_seen_at AS last_seen_at, admin.finding.resolved_at AS resolved_at, admin.finding.status AS status, admin.finding.reviewed_by AS reviewed_by, admin.finding.reviewed_at AS reviewed_at, admin.finding.ignored_until AS ignored_until, admin.finding.comment AS comment, admin.finding.assigned_to AS assigned_to, admin.finding.reviewed_subject AS reviewed_subject, admin.finding.snoozed_until AS snoozed_until, admin.finding.exception_reason AS exception_reason 
FROM admin.finding 
WHERE admin.finding.status != :status_1 ORDER BY coalesce(CAST(admin.finding.metadata[:metadata_1] ->> :param_1 AS INTEGER), CASE WHEN (admin.finding.severity = :severity_1) THEN :param_2 WHEN (admin.finding.severity = :severity_2) THEN :param_3 WHEN (admin.finding.severity = :severity_3) THEN :param_4 END) DESC, admin.finding.id COLLATE "C" 
 LIMIT :param_5 OFFSET :param_6

SELECT admin.finding.id AS id, admin.finding.rule AS rule, admin.finding.severity AS severity, admin.finding.entity_type AS entity_type, admin.finding.entity_id AS entity_key, admin.finding.field AS field, admin.finding.message AS message, admin.finding.first_seen_at AS first_seen_at, admin.finding.last_seen_at AS last_seen_at, admin.finding.resolved_at AS resolved_at, admin.finding.status AS status, admin.finding.reviewed_by AS reviewed_by, admin.finding.reviewed_at AS reviewed_at, admin.finding.ignored_until AS ignored_until, admin.finding.comment AS comment, admin.finding.assigned_to AS assigned_to, admin.finding.reviewed_subject AS reviewed_subject, admin.finding.snoozed_until AS snoozed_until, admin.finding.exception_reason AS exception_reason

 LIMIT 4 OFFSET 0;

post_processing: period_window, source timezone, persisted_counts (unresolved), urgent metadata, check status; geo membership batches
period_window() bestimmt [Start, Ende) mit ADMIN_TIMEZONE; Quellzeiten werden mit URANUS_TIMESTAMP_TIMEZONE interpretiert.
persisted_counts(): resolved wird ausgeschlossen. Dringend: Priorität 1/2 oder published_soon aus gespeicherten Metadaten.
Die Arbeitslisten-Vorschau ist eine separate Findings-Abfrage (active_only=true, vier Zeilen, gewählter Schweregrad).
Prüfstatus ist unabhängig vom Zeitraum. Python summiert die pro Regel gespeicherten Counts.
notes: Diese Ansicht besteht aus mehreren Abfragen und zusätzlicher Anwendungslogik. Definitionen führen keine View-SQL aus.
Ausführung: maximal 50 Ergebniszeilen je Query. LIMIT/OFFSET der View bleiben innen erhalten; die Inspektion ergänzt eine äußere Begrenzung.

sources.sql:
SELECT entity_type,entity_key,entity_name,
        organization_id,organization_name,status,created_at AT TIME ZONE :tz created_at
        FROM ((
SELECT 'organization'::text entity_type, o.uuid::text entity_key, o.name entity_name,
       o.uuid organization_id, o.name organization_name, o.created_at, NULL::text status
FROM uranus.organization o
 WHERE FALSE) UNION ALL 
SELECT 'venue', v.uuid::text, v.name, o.uuid, o.name, v.created_at, NULL
FROM uranus.venue v LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=v.org_uuid
) a WHERE entity_key=:key

SELECT count(*) FROM (WITH links(entity_type,entity_key) AS (SELECT 'organization' entity_type,(v.org_uuid)::text entity_key FROM uranus.venue v WHERE (v.uuid)=:id::UUID AND (v.org_uuid) IS NOT NULL AND TRUE UNION SELECT 'space' entity_type,(s.uuid)::text entity_key FROM uranus.space s WHERE (s.venue_uuid)=:id::UUID AND (s.uuid) IS NOT NULL AND TRUE UNION SELECT 'event' entity_type,(e.uuid)::text entity_key FROM uranus.event e WHERE (e.venue_uuid)=:id::UUID AND (e.uuid) IS NOT NULL AND TRUE UNION SELECT 'event_date' entity_type,(d.uuid)::text entity_key FROM uranus.event_date d JOIN uranus.event e ON e.uuid=d.event_uuid WHERE (COALESCE(d.venue_uuid,e.venue_uuid))=:id::UUID AND (d.uuid) IS NOT NULL AND TRUE UNION SELECT 'image',pluto_image_uuid::text FROM uranus.pluto_image_link WHERE context='venue' AND context_uuid=:id::UUID), a AS (
SELECT 'organization'::text entity_type, o.uuid::text entity_key, o.name entity_name,
       o.uuid organization_id, o.name organization_name, o.created_at, NULL::text status
FROM uranus.organization o

UNION ALL

SELECT 'venue', v.uuid::text, v.name, o.uuid, o.name, v.created_at, NULL
FROM uranus.venue v LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=v.org_uuid

UNION ALL

SELECT 'space', s.uuid::text, s.name, o.uuid, o.name, s.created_at, NULL
FROM uranus.space s LEFT JOIN uranus.venue v ON v.uuid=s.venue_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=v.org_uuid

UNION ALL

SELECT 'event', e.uuid::text, e.title, o.uuid, o.name, e.created_at, e.release_status::text
FROM uranus.event e LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=e.org_uuid

UNION ALL

SELECT 'event_date', d.uuid::text, COALESCE(e.title,d.uuid::text), o.uuid, o.name,
       d.created_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.release_status::text,'inherited'),e.release_status::text)
FROM uranus.event_date d LEFT JOIN uranus.event e ON e.uuid=d.event_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=e.org_uuid

UNION ALL

SELECT 'user', u.uuid::text, COALESCE(u.display_name,u.username,u.uuid::text), NULL, NULL,
       u.created_at, CASE WHEN u.is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END
FROM uranus."user" u

UNION ALL
SELECT 'partner_request', 'partner-request:'||p.from_org_uuid||':'||p.to_org_uuid,
       COALESCE(f.name,p.from_org_uuid::text)||' → '||COALESCE(t.name,p.to_org_uuid::text),
       p.from_org_uuid, f.name, p.created_at, p.status
FROM uranus.organization_partner_request p
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization f ON f.uuid=p.from_org_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization t ON t.uuid=p.to_org_uuid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'team_membership', 'membership:'||m.org_uuid||':'||m.user_uuid,
       COALESCE(u.display_name,u.username,m.user_uuid::text), m.org_uuid, o.name, m.created_at,
       CASE WHEN m.has_joined THEN 'joined' ELSE 'invited' END
FROM uranus.organization_member_link m LEFT JOIN uranus.organization o ON o.uuid=m.org_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus."user" u ON u.uuid=m.user_uuid
UNION ALL
SELECT 'image', i.uuid::text, COALESCE(i.alt_text,i.uuid::text), NULL,NULL,i.created_at,NULL
FROM uranus.pluto_image i
)
        SELECT a.* FROM a JOIN links USING (entity_type,entity_key)) r

   AND ((l.context='organization' AND l.identifier='main_logo')
     OR (l.context='venue' AND l.identifier IN ('main_photo','main_logo'))
     OR (l.context='event' AND l.identifier='main'))
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.identifier='main_photo' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,l.identifier,i.uuid LIMIT 1

sources.sql:
SELECT s.* FROM (
SELECT p.from_org_uuid, p.to_org_uuid, p.from_user_uuid AS user_id, p.status, p.created_at,
 f.name AS from_name, t.name AS to_name, COALESCE(u.display_name,u.username) AS user_name,
 u.uuid IS NOT NULL AS user_exists,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM uranus.organization_access_grants g
        WHERE g.src_org_uuid=p.to_org_uuid AND g.dst_org_uuid=p.from_org_uuid) AS grant_exists
FROM uranus.organization_partner_request p
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization f ON f.uuid=p.from_org_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus.organization t ON t.uuid=p.to_org_uuid
LEFT JOIN uranus."user" u ON u.uuid=p.from_user_uuid
) s WHERE TRUE AND (status)=:status ORDER BY (CASE WHEN (created_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone) <= :now THEN floor(extract(epoch FROM (CAST(:now AS timestamptz) - (created_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone))) / 86400)::integer END) DESC NULLS LAST, ('partner-request:' || from_org_uuid::text || ':' || to_org_uuid::text) COLLATE "C" LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
